CICCONE RECORDS · ELIE

Elie

Elie Ciccone Carey Smith (born March 2, 2000, in New York City) is an American singer, songwriter, producer, actress, dancer, writer, and entrepreneur. Known for her commercial success and artistic evolution, she has released albums including Mon Amoure, Saint, Aquamarine, and DISCO DIVA. A recipient of eight Grammy Awards, she is also the founder of Ciccone Records.
